You have a unique weapon integrated into your hardlight body, perhaps a bladed arm, a shoulder-mounted cryo cannon, or a kiss attack that fires sparkling cartoon hearts. When you select this feat, you gain one of the following unarmed attacks of your choice. Each of these attacks has the unarmed trait.

  • A melee unarmed attack that deals 1d8 damage.

  • A melee unarmed attack that deals 1d6 damage and has the agile and finesse traits.

  • A ranged unarmed attack that deals 1d6 damage and has a range increment of 30 feet.

  • A ranged unarmed attack that deals 1d4 damage and has a range increment of 60 feet.

Once you make this decision, select the type of damage your weapon deals and an associated weapon group from among the following options: acid (corrosive weapon group), bludgeoning (brawling, club, or hammer weapon group), cold (cryo weapon group), electricity (shock weapon group), fire (flame or laser weapon group), piercing (brawling, knife, or spear weapon group), slashing (brawling, knife, or sword weapon group), or sonic (sonic weapon group).

At 5th level, whenever you get a critical hit with your hardlight weapon, you get its critical specialization effect.
